implemented_subset.bpm_basis: Six native options in REAPER order: 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1/8 dotted, 1/4 dotted, 1/2 dotted; default 1/4. BPM is interpreted as beats of the selected note value.
implemented_subset.start_measure: Signed i32 displayed measure at tick zero; 0 and -2 accepted by native UI and AAADAW
implemented_subset.project_start_time: Signed project clock display offset; shifts ruler/transport and absolute item time displays without moving media samples or changing musical positions
implemented_subset.musical_positions: Signed displayed bars round-trip in Beats properties and anchor timeline ruler labels
implemented_subset.base_ruler_label_spacing: Checked by default; checked uses start_measure as the ruler-label interval phase, unchecked uses measure 1
implemented_subset.apply: one atomic transaction: changed fields among SetTempo@0 + SetTimeSignature@0 + SetProjectStartMeasure + SetProjectBpmBasis + SetBaseRulerLabelSpacingOnMeasure + SetProjectStartTimeOffsetSeconds

limitations: Display time offset is implemented; display timebase, beat-synced audio item storage, sample rate and resampling settings remain unimplemented
Default values came from the owned ReaScript probe; the native dialog was inspected for signed Start measure behavior, but no REAPER screenshot is committed
